answer: Stop sybil graders with gold-item calibration traps. The network hides one pre-scored answer per batch, a whisper of ground truth only the scheduler knows. Each seat grades eleven real answers plus the gold item blind, scores thread through with no marker. Missing gold by over one point on the 0-3 scale earns a strike; two strikes in six epochs burns the 300 POA bond and voids that seat plus kin seats. Fielding 5,000 fakes locks 1,500,000 POA while 417 traps per epoch expose the herd in 12 days. Like a meadow sown with marked bills: grab all the grass, the marked notes still point back.
